proposal.description: window_trip is written as an 'any window tripped' summary that also carries the soft-start trip, instead of reporting only the S_RUN window.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, when fault_count_ss reaches trip_ss, window_trip asserts together with window_trip_SS, although window_trip must stay low outside S_RUN. Downstream logic would then see a run-window overcurrent during soft start.

proposal.description: The blanking history is also cleared at high-side turn-off (falling edge of pwm_sync), so that it holds only low-side samples, instead of being cleared only while neither S_SS nor S_RUN is active.
proposal.reason: At a high duty cycle, where pwm_sync stays low for fewer than BLANK_CLKS clocks, the bit tapped at pwm_rise is the cleared 0 and not the comparator value from BLANK_CLKS clocks earlier. A cycle with CP high is then counted as clean, so fault_count_run_out and fault_count_ss_out stay at 0 and window_trip / window_trip_SS never assert.
